channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lionel Hollins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lionel Hollins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Conley on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Impending free agent Grizzlies PG Mike Conley on the Nets firing his former coach Lionel Hollins and it potentially impacting his decision to possibly sign with Brooklyn over the summer:

“It's tough but at the same time like I said I'll give everybody their fair shot. Lionel being here obviously was a big reason to look (at Brooklyn) but still at the same time with him gone I'll give everybody the same look.”

Mike Conley on Lionel Hollins, Feb 10, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins:

“He’s a fighter. He’ll go out and do it the way he thinks is best to do it & he won’t apologize for it. It works. He's a super human being & a tremendous coach.”

Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins, Jan 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Clay Bailey:Dave Joerger:

“We care about (Hollins) deeply & tried to reach out to him. Commenting on the situation, I don't know what all was involved there.”

Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins, Jan 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @claybailey9.

item.title: Paul Westphal on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Cindy, Paul Westphal's wife, on Facebook:

“Paul's loyalty was and is to Lionel. It would be too hard to remain without him. Like Paul always says,”

Paul Westphal on Lionel Hollins, Jan 10, 2016. Source: Facebook.com.

item.title: Bojan Bogdanovic on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Bojan Bogdanovic on being benched by Lionel Hollins:

“He’s trying to something probably because we lose (a) couple games in a row.”

Bojan Bogdanovic on Lionel Hollins, Jan 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Billy King on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
“And I’m management so there was no truth to that. Lionel and I are working hard every day. We’re discussing possibilities, things we can do on the court, off the court. I’ve talked to ownership and right now, Lionel is our coach and we’re working to try to turn this around.”

Billy King on Lionel Hollins, Dec 8, 2015. Source: Bergen Record.

item.title: Billy King on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
“Shoot, I'm in the last year of my deal, too. And that's why I think I said before it's not just Lionel. We're all in this together.”

Billy King on Lionel Hollins, Nov 9, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mikhail Prokhorov on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Prokhorov on Hollins:

“I like him a lot, because I like people who know what they want to reach the result. Lionel definitely does that.”

Mikhail Prokhorov on Lionel Hollins, Sep 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Billy King on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
King was adamant that the reports that first-year coach Lionel Hollins' job is in jeopardy are absolutely false.

“I don't know where that story came from about Lionel, but it's not true,”

Billy King on Lionel Hollins, Feb 6, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Stackhouse said of his future job prospects.

“I like Lionel Hollins, and I like Jason Kidd, too. That came about really quickly. But sometimes you need a change of scenery.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Lionel Hollins, Jul 22, 2014. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Barry Hecker on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Finally, Hecker said,

“I stood up and said to him, ‘Lionel, you don’t want to hear the truth. You don’t want to know what the hell is going on.’ Bottom line is, I said, ‘I am tired of the bull----, I am just going to walk out of here right now.’ I never said quit or anything.”

Barry Hecker on Lionel Hollins, Dec 9, 2013. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Barry Hecker on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Hecker disagreed.

“I told Lionel two years ago, I said, ‘Lionel, this (guy) is going to get your job one day if you don’t watch yourself,’”

Barry Hecker on Lionel Hollins, Dec 9, 2013. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Geoff Calkins:Joerger on succeeding Hollins:

“This is Lionel's job. When it wasn't Lionel's job, then I'm interested.”

Dave Joerger on Lionel Hollins, Jun 27, 2013. Source: Twitter @geoff_calkins.

item.title: Mike Conley on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Conley on Hollins:

“It’s tough to lose Lionel. He helped a lot of guys go from being boys to men at a vulnerable time in our careers.”

Mike Conley on Lionel Hollins, Jun 27, 2013. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBlog.

item.title: Jason Levien on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
The Memphis Grizzlies announced that the team will not offer Head Coach Lionel Hollins a new contract when it expires on Sunday, June 30 and effectively immediately, he is no longer with the organization.

“After a thorough internal process, which included conversations with Lionel and his representatives, we decided as an organization to move in a different direction,”

Jason Levien on Lionel Hollins, Jun 11, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:Gasol:

“But I believe Coach (Hollins) brought a mentality that I was used to – hard work, no excuses and treating everybody the same.”

Marc Gasol on Lionel Hollins, Apr 24, 2013. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBlog.

item.title: Tony Allen on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
“He’s just been plain old, hard-nosed Hollins. I like it. He’s been keeping his composure and willing us to victories. That’s big for us.”

Tony Allen on Lionel Hollins, Apr 11, 2013. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Jason Levien on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Jason Levien on Hollins' contract situation:

“I don’t think it behooves us to speak publicly about any kind of contract situation. We had a great meeting with Lionel and I’ve certainly enjoyed the interaction he and I have had over the past several months. He has a proven track record that’s very impressive as a coach. We see him as a big asset to the team.”

Jason Levien on Lionel Hollins, Feb 12, 2013. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Robert Pera on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
Robert Pera on Hollins' contract situation:

“I think all that for now is confidential. The final decision will come down to Jason and I’ll approve whichever direction he wants to go.”

Robert Pera on Lionel Hollins, Feb 12, 2013. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Tony Allen on Lionel Hollins
item.description:
“We've shown flashes of it. Coach (Lionel Hollins) said this year that consistency will be the key. Everybody has to be all in. The more we build on that the more confident upstairs will be about keeping us together.”

Tony Allen on Lionel Hollins, Oct 31, 2012. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.
